service.name: Solo piano
service.serviceType: Solo pianist for cocktail hours, client dinners, galas and dinner parties
service.description: A solo pianist playing standards and covers at conversation volume for client dinners, galas, hotel ballroom dinners, dinner parties, Sunday brunches and memorial services across Denver, the Front Range and the Colorado mountain corridor, with a voice added when the evening wants singing.

faqs.a: Standards and covers, from the Great American Songbook to Elton John and Billy Joel, played through arrival, cocktails and dinner. The set can lean jazz, lean pop or move between the two as the evening goes on. It's booked through Signet Artists in Denver.

faqs.q: Does the venue need a piano?
faqs.a: No. When the venue has one, the pianist plays it, and it only needs the tuning the venue already keeps up. When it doesn't, a stage piano and a small sound system come with the booking, set up in a corner of about 6 by 4 feet with one dedicated 20-amp circuit and 45 minutes to set up.

About as loud as the conversation at the table, so two people across from each other hear each other and the piano both. A pianist sets the level to the space: in a small dining space the stage piano plays barely amplified, and in a ballroom the sound support carries it to the back tables without getting loud at the front ones.

faqs.q: Can we ask for a song, or add time?
faqs.a: Yes. The pianist learns one song of your choosing as part of every booking, and if the dinner runs long, another half hour is easy to add on the night. An announcement microphone is ready for the toast or the remarks.
